Oil Prices Fall on Hopes for Peace Between U.S. and Iran — The global benchmark price is down roughly $20 a barrel since late October, when it traded for around $113.

France Blames Iran for Cyberattack on Refrigeration Systems — The French foreign minister said he had summoned the Iranian ambassador to France after a cyberattack on hundreds of supermarkets last month. Iran did not immediately respond.

3 REASONS Trump is RAPIDLY LOSING CONTROL in his war with Iran — With the historic Republican losses in the midterm elections, experts and analysts are weighing the impact on President Trump's war with Iran. MS NOW's David Rohde breaks down the three reasons why the president may have even fewer options now to end the conflict.
Qatar PM meets with Trump for talks on ending war on Iran — Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani has met with US President Donald Trump.
Yemen government forces claim new advances as Houthi border attacks resume — Yemeni forces claim fresh advances across key fronts as cross-border Houthi attacks surge amid heavy clashes.

Here Are the Difficult Options Trump Is Weighing to Resolve the War in Iran — There are no good choices facing President Trump as he tries to find a way out of the deeply unpopular conflict. But there are choices.

Hegseth IMPEACHMENT LOOMS As Trump Doubles Down On Iran — Krystal and Saagar discuss Hegseth facing a potential impeachment over the Iran war in the House. France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks — France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.

Trump KNIFES JD Vance On Iran War — Krystal and Saagar discuss Trump confronted on 60 minutes on the GOP's midterm losses. France blames Iran for last month's cyberattack on supermarket fridges — France on Monday blamed Iran for last month's massive cyberattack on supermarket fridges, summoned the Iranian ambassador and said it would seek European sanctions against those responsible for the attack.

Thomas Massie files articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth — The articles accuse Hegseth of "high crimes and misdemeanors," including for waging war against Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution.

Rubio's defense of Trump's Iran war draws sharp contrast with Vance's midterm blame — JD Vance blamed the Iran war for Republicans' midterm losses, raising questions about his 2028 ambitions and his shift from Trump on the conflict.

Hegseth impeachment vote looms as House Republicans privately warn it could pass — Several House Republicans believe Pete Hegseth's impeachment could pass as Rep. Thomas Massie forces a privileged resolution vote this week.

Gaza-born Democratic Socialist launches primary bid against Sen John Fetterman — Democratic Socialists of America member Ahmed Moor launched a Pennsylvania primary challenge against Sen. John Fetterman over Israel support.

WATCH: Hegseth announces he will hold news conference on impeachment threat to defend his record — Facing an expected impeachment resolution in Congress, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he's eager to litigate the policy choices that he and President Donald Trump have made in Iran and Venezuela.

Trump meets key Iran war mediator as UAE reveals major oil export surge despite conflict — Trump met Qatar's prime minister at the White House as Marco Rubio warns Iran negotiations are far from a breakthrough amid Strait of Hormuz chaos.

Boosting healthcare and ending the Iran war are top of the to-do list for House Democrats once they have majority — The legislative flurry carries enormous stakes for Democrats as they seek to translate their sweeping victories in the midterms into achievements that deliver on their promises to lower the cost of living.

Lame-Duck Donald. Plus. . . — In today’s Front Page, Carrie McKean meets the voters who swung Texas, River Page on how normies won the middle, and Charles Lane says transgender ideology is still a losing issue.

Trump-aligned Mississippi auditor launches governor bid, vows to dismantle 'good ol' boys' club' — Mississippi State Auditor Shad White says his office uncovered $75 million in misspent funds and vows to shut down the state's "rotten system."

Rubio defends Trump's Iran war as not 'necessarily popular, but necessary' — Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended Trump's Iran war as "necessary" to prevent a nuclear weapon, even as he ties it to Republican midterm losses.

Congress returns to brutal lame-duck stretch with shutdown deadline, leadership races: 'Closet is full of s—' — Lawmakers return to Capitol Hill facing a government shutdown deadline, the farm bill and a debt ceiling fight before Democrats take power in January.

Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill? — Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.

J.D. Vance Wants to ‘Change Our Relationship to Israel.’ Does His Boss Agree? — The president’s next move will determine the direction of the Iran war, shape the balance of power in the Middle East, and define his geopolitical legacy, writes Michael Doran.

More Than 50 Killed in Yemen in One of the Deadliest 24 Hours of the War — Strikes show the heavy toll since fighting between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government reignited in August, with civilians paying a heavy price.

Iran vows ‘astonishing’ strikes and lifts missile-range limit as US targets land routes — Iran's IRGC lifted its 2,000-kilometer ballistic missile-range limit and threatened new weapons hours after U.S. Central Command launched a new task force.

Saudi Aramco Tower Damaged as Yemen’s Houthis Attack Riyadh — The Saudi authorities said no one was hurt after “falling shrapnel” hit the building in Riyadh’s financial district — one of the highest-profile areas targeted by the Houthis.
